name: notebooklm-py / NotebookLM MCP

auth.credential_warning: Stored cookies or master-token material are account credentials and must never be committed or logged.

footprint.browser_extra: interactive login may download Chromium; upstream documents roughly 170 MB

permissions.notes: The MCP surface manages notebooks/sources/artifacts and therefore includes mutations. Cognitive OS must not treat it as read-only.

known_risks: Consumer NotebookLM backends rely on undocumented Google APIs and may change without notice.
Authentication material can be account-equivalent and requires local secret handling.
The MCP server is documented upstream as experimental/preview and its tool surface is not covered by normal semver guarantees.
Remote deployment materially increases security complexity and is not part of the default Cognitive OS setup.

gauntlet.reason: Identity, release, license, install/auth and MCP surface are verified from upstream. Final supported status still requires Cognitive OS host-matrix installation/preflight tests.
